diagnosis: Composing the actual namespace helper, installed Docker CLI and real closed worker proxy against fake daemons reproduced an earlier rejection: Docker serializes unset MemorySwappiness as-1. After narrowly accepting that inherited/default sentinel, the32 MiB probe's implicit64 MiB shared memory reproduces the second refusal; the explicit8 MiB helper correction makes the complete create admissible. No real container is started by these tests.
unchanged_guards: MemorySwap must still equal Memory, so inherited swappiness does not authorize swap. Caller-selected swappiness, unrelated negative/unlimited resource sentinels, privilege, namespaces, core/seccomp, source binding, labels, mounts and CPU/memory/PID caps remain enforced.

validation.counterfactual: Both composed tests failed at the closed namespace/privilege boundary before the inherited-default correction. After it, removing only the8 MiB helper argument is rejected specifically by shared-memory accounting, while the corrected helper reaches only the deliberately refusing fake daemon.
